These are Node runtime witnesses for the process tests that construct typed IR explicitly. They are not source compiler acceptance fixtures and are deliberately outside the top-level compile-and-flow glob. The corresponding node_process_*_test.go tests still run each witness on Node and compare both generated backends. TestNodeProcessErrorNarrowingBlocker additionally verifies the exact adaptation-47 helper and its current `in` refusal. Compiler acceptance fixtures remain in the top-level testdata directory and stage3/fixtures/host.
